title: Read the doc_viewer key and inject its URL prefix into both session-start surfaces
action: Add `pub fn doc_viewer_prefix(config: &Map<String, Value>) -> Option<String>` to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/state.rs, beside bypass_level (:197) and ship_visibility (:209) which take the same argument. It reads config["doc_viewer"] as an object with two string fields, base_url and project: trim one trailing '/' off base_url, strip surrounding '/' off project, return Some("<base>/p/<project>"). Absent key => None, silent (that is the default). Half-set (one field only, either field empty after trim, doc_viewer not an object, a field not a string) => None PLUS one stderr line naming the key, in the same shape ship_visibility uses at state.rs:214 for an unrecognized value. Then render it in the two places a session actually starts. (a) session_preamble/budget.rs: a `### Doc links` section placed IMMEDIATELY AFTER the Standard commands block at :276-303 -- never appended at the end, because session_preamble/tests.rs:49-52 pins the closing trailer (budget.rs:421) with ends_with. The section names the prefix and the rule: append the repo-relative path, link docs as URLs rather than bare paths. Config is already in hand there via read_config_raw_open at budget.rs:207. (b) hooks/compaction.rs: the same single line as an item in the survival capsule, following item 10's pattern at :1485-1495, reading config through read_config_failopen (:124) exactly as compaction.rs:180 already does for bypass_level. Both injectors call the ONE shared fn in state.rs; neither reaches state.rs:157.

truths: doc_viewer_prefix returns Some("http://host:7700/p/slug") for a well-formed key, with a trailing slash on base_url and surrounding slashes on project both normalized away
an absent doc_viewer key returns None and writes nothing to stderr; a half-set or wrong-typed one returns None and writes exactly one stderr line naming the key
config.local.json overrides tracked config.json for doc_viewer, through the existing merge
with the key set, the session preamble carries a Doc links section right after Standard commands; with it unset the preamble is byte-identical to today
with the key set, the compaction survival capsule carries the same prefix line, so the prefix survives a compaction
the preamble budget test's fixture config (tests.rs:258-262) includes doc_viewer, and the whole block still fits PREAMBLE_BUDGET_BYTES (budget.rs:43)

trace.outcome: Added doc_viewer_prefix reader in state.rs and rendered it in the session preamble (Doc links section) and compaction capsule, with unit and render coverage; full cargo test suite green
